description: Render a slab from the Austin yard onto a photo of the user's own kitchen or bath, and return the image with a price estimate. Pass a public image URL of the room (JPEG/PNG/WebP) and a stone slug from search_stones. Rendering takes about 30-90 seconds; if it is not ready in time, call get_visualization with the returned id.

room_image_url.description: Public URL of a photo of the room, countertops visible

sqft.description: Countertop square feet, for the price estimate

name: visualize_kitchen
title: See a stone on your kitchen
